tools.name: staffwise_get_shifts
tools.description: Read the shift details that Staffwise reports for one job over a date range. Use a job id from Jobs > View Jobs. Staffwise API: POST /api/campaigns/get-data/{job-id}. The response is returned as the vendor sent it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: staffwise_get_shifts · Public sink: staffwise_get_shifts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: staffwise_get_shifts · Public sink: staffwise_get_shifts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
